title: Do so; such
summary: Do so (формальная замена глагольной группы) и such: so vs such, such as, as such, no such thing.
ru:
## do so: формальная замена глагольной группы
**do so** повторяет глагол с дополнением, который уже был назван. Это формальная стратегия письменной речи (инструкции, документы, новости).
> The council asked residents to conserve water, and most **did so** immediately. (= conserved water)
> Anyone wishing to apply may **do so** online. (= apply online)
> If you have a complaint, please **do so** in writing.
> He promised to call, but **failed to do so**.
В обычной разговорной речи вместо *do so* чаще скажут *do it / do that / do the same*. Форма *do* изменяется: *did so, doing so, to do so, having done so, does so*. Конструкция *in doing so* означает «делая это» и часто звучит в новостях: *He took a huge risk and, in doing so, lost his job.*

## Ограничения do so
1. Глагол должен выражать **контролируемое действие**, а не состояние: ~~She knows French, and her brother does so too.~~ (*know* — состояние) → ...and so does her brother. Нельзя и с *be, have, like, want, seem*.
2. После *do so* **нельзя** ставить дополнение: ~~They did so it.~~ Дополнение уже заменено.
3. Чаще всего *do so* стоит после *to*, модального глагола, *failed to*, *may*, *must* и в сочетании с *in / by / after doing so*.
Сравните: *He asked me to lock the door, and I did it.* (разговорно) и *Staff who wish to leave early must do so with permission.* (формально).

## such + существительное, so + прилагательное
Главное правило, которое путают даже сильные ученики:
| **so** + прилагательное / наречие | **such** + (a / an) + (прилагательное) + существительное |
|---|---|
| The film was **so** boring. | It was **such a** boring film. |
| She sings **so** well. | She has **such a** lovely voice. |
> ~~It was so a hot day.~~ → It was **such a** hot day. / The day was **so** hot.
> ~~She is such clever.~~ → She is **so** clever. / She is **such a** clever girl.
С неисчисляемыми и множественными существительными *a* не нужен: *such beautiful weather, such good friends*. Следствие вводится через **that** (в разговоре *that* опускают): *It was such a loud noise that I woke up.* В очень формальном стиле встречается *so + adj + a + noun*: *so nice a day*.
Неисчисляемое с количеством: *so much work, so many people, so few chances*, но британское *such a lot of work* — разговорно.

## such в значении «такой, подобный»
> I've never said **any such** thing. — Я никогда ничего подобного не говорил.
> There's **no such** thing as a free lunch. — Бесплатных обедов не бывает.
> **Such** behaviour is unacceptable. — Такое поведение недопустимо.
**such as** = «например, вроде»: *Countries such as Peru and Bolivia have high mountains.* **as such** = «как таковой»: *He is not a lawyer as such, but he knows the law.* **and such** (разговорно) = «и тому подобное». **Such is / was** — книжное «таково»: *Such was the force of the blast that windows shattered.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~They did so it quickly.~~ → They **did so** quickly.
- ~~so beautiful weather~~ → **such** beautiful weather.
- ~~I have never seen so a crowd.~~ → I have never seen **such a** crowd.
- ~~Cities like as Venice~~ → Cities **such as** Venice.
en:
## do so: a formal substitute for a verb phrase
**do so** repeats a verb phrase (with its object) that has already been mentioned. It is formal and typical of instructions, documents and news.
> The council asked residents to conserve water, and most **did so** immediately.
> Anyone wishing to apply may **do so** online.
> If you have a complaint, please **do so** in writing.
> He promised to call, but **failed to do so**.
In speech people use *do it / do that / do the same* instead. *Do* changes form: *did so, doing so, to do so, having done so, does so*. *In doing so* means "by / while doing this": *He took a huge risk and, in doing so, lost his job.*

## Limits of do so
1. The verb must express a **controlled action**, not a state: ~~She knows French, and her brother does so too.~~ → ...and so does her brother. It cannot replace *be, have, like, want, seem*.
2. You cannot add an object after *do so*: ~~They did so it.~~
3. It is typical after *to*, modals, *failed to*, and in *in / by / after doing so*.
Compare *I asked him to lock the door and he did it* (informal) with *Staff who wish to leave early must do so with permission* (formal).

## such + noun, so + adjective
| **so** + adjective / adverb | **such** + (a / an) + (adjective) + noun |
|---|---|
| The film was **so** boring. | It was **such a** boring film. |
| She sings **so** well. | She has **such a** lovely voice. |
> ~~It was so a hot day.~~ → It was **such a** hot day. / The day was **so** hot.
> ~~She is such clever.~~ → She is **so** clever. / She is **such a** clever girl.
With uncountable and plural nouns there is no *a*: *such beautiful weather, such good friends*. The result clause starts with **that** (often dropped in speech): *It was such a loud noise that I woke up.* Very formal English has *so nice a day*. With quantity: *so much work, so many people, so few chances*; British *such a lot of work* is informal.

## such meaning "of that kind"
> I've never said **any such** thing.
> There's **no such** thing as a free lunch.
> **Such** behaviour is unacceptable.
**such as** = "for example": *Countries such as Peru and Bolivia have high mountains.* **as such** = "in itself, strictly": *He is not a lawyer as such, but he knows the law.* **and such** (informal) = "and things like that". **Such is / was** is literary: *Such was the force of the blast that windows shattered.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~They did so it quickly.~~ → They **did so** quickly.
- ~~so beautiful weather~~ → **such** beautiful weather.
- ~~I have never seen so a crowd.~~ → I have never seen **such a** crowd.
- ~~Cities like as Venice~~ → Cities **such as** Venice.
structure:
## so или such
| Структура | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| so | so + adj / adv | so boring · so well |
| so (количество) | so much / many / few / little + noun | so many people |
| such | such + a / an + (adj) + sing. noun | such a boring film |
| such | such + (adj) + plural / uncountable noun | such good friends |
| результат | so / such ... that | such a noise that I woke up |

## do so
| Форма | Пример |
|---|---|
| do so | You may do so online. |
| did so | They did so at once. |
| failed to do so | He failed to do so. |
| in doing so | In doing so, he lost his job. |
| having done so | Having done so, she left. |

## Значения such
| Выражение | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| such as | например | cities such as Rome |
| any such / no such | подобный | There's no such place. |
| as such | как таковой | not a doctor as such |
| and such | и тому подобное | pens, paper and such |
| Such is / was | таково | Such is life. |

exercises.title: do so, so или such?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное слово (или два слова: do so).

items.text: The council asked residents to conserve water, and most {{did so}} immediately.
If you wish to complain, you may {{do so}} in writing.
He promised to call me, but failed to {{do so}}.
It was {{such}} a long speech that people started leaving.
The film was {{so}} boring that I nearly fell asleep.
Countries {{such}} as Peru and Bolivia have high mountains.

exercises.title: Формальные и устойчивые обороты
exercises.instruction: Вставьте одно слово или форму по подсказке.

items.text: Having {{done}} so, the jury returned to the courtroom.
He took a huge risk and, in {{doing}} so, lost his job.
{{Such}} was the force of the explosion that windows broke three streets away.
He isn't a lawyer {{as}} such, but he knows the law very well.
I didn't expect {{such}} a warm welcome.
She felt {{so}} nervous that her hands were shaking.
Applicants who fail to {{do}} so by Friday will be excluded.

items.q: It was ___ a hot day that we stayed indoors.
The talk was ___ interesting that nobody left.
She told us to wait, and we ___ so.
Cities ___ as Venice attract millions of tourists.
There's ___ thing as a free lunch.
Какой вариант подходит для разговорной речи? I haven't cleaned the kitchen yet, but I'll ___ later.
items.why: В разговоре — **do it**; *do so* звучит формально.

items.q: Visitors who wish to speak to the manager may ___ by appointment.

options: She wanted to leave early, and she did so.
She knew the answer, and she did so.
She was tired, and she did so.
items.why: *Do so* заменяет контролируемое действие (*leave early*), а не состояние (*know, be*).

items.q: It was ___ lovely weather that we stayed outside all day.
We have ___ work this week that I can't take a day off.

exercises.title: Перепишите
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слова в скобках.

items.prompt: The manager told the staff to leave early, and they left early. Замените повтор на did so.
answers: The manager told the staff to leave early, and they did so.

items.prompt: Anyone who wants to enter the competition can enter it online. Используйте do so.
answers: Anyone who wants to enter the competition can do so online.

items.prompt: It was a very bad storm. We couldn't go out. Соедините: such ... that
answers: It was such a bad storm that we couldn't go out.
It was such a bad storm that we could not go out.

items.prompt: The coffee was very strong. I couldn't sleep. Соедините: so ... that
answers: The coffee was so strong that I couldn't sleep.
The coffee was so strong that I could not sleep.

items.prompt: I never said that. Используйте any such.
answers: I never said any such thing.
I have never said any such thing.
I've never said any such thing.

items.prompt: Fruits like apples and pears are cheap in autumn. Используйте such as.
answers: Fruits such as apples and pears are cheap in autumn.

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите на английский. Ключевые слова даны.

answers: It was such an interesting film!
It was such an interesting film.

items.prompt: Она была так счастлива, что заплакала. (so)
answers: She was so happy that she cried.
She was so happy she cried.

items.prompt: Я никогда не видел такого дома. (such)
answers: I've never seen such a house.
I have never seen such a house.

items.prompt: Если вы хотите возразить, вы можете сделать это письменно. (do so)
answers: If you wish to object, you may do so in writing.
If you wish to object, you can do so in writing.
If you want to object, you may do so in writing.
If you want to object, you can do so in writing.

items.prompt: Он обещал позвонить, но не позвонил. (fail / do so)
answers: He promised to call but failed to do so.
He promised to call, but failed to do so.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложения по образцу. Образцы — для самопроверки.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение с such a ... that о вашем самом занятом дне.
items.sample: It was such a busy day that I forgot to eat lunch.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение с so ... that о вашем любимом фильме или книге.
items.sample: The book was so gripping that I finished it in one night.

items.prompt: Напишите, что человек может сделать на сайте вашего банка или университета, используя do so.
items.sample: Students can register for courses online; most of them do so in September.

items.prompt: Назовите три города или страны, используя such as.
items.sample: I'd like to visit cities such as Lisbon, Kyoto and Cape Town.

items.prompt: Напишите о чём-то, чего вы никогда не говорили / не делали, с any such.
items.sample: I have never made any such promise.
